segments.text:
V. 7.
They bought with them the potters field—Well known, it ſeems, by that Name. This was a ſmall Price for a Field ſo near Jeruſalem. But the Earth had probable been digged for Potters Veſſels, ſo that it was now neither fit for Tillage, nor Paſture, and conſequently of ſmall Value. Foreigners—Heathens eſpecially, of whom there were then great Numbers in Jeruſalem.
